A default [``](/docs/app/api-reference/components/link) loads the route's [**App Shell**](/docs/app/glossary#app-shell). It holds the route's static output and, for routes that read [`cookies()`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/cookies) or [`headers()`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/headers), its session-specific UI. Links to the same route share it. 2. A [``](/docs/app/api-reference/components/link#prefetch), or [`router.prefetch(href, { kind: 'full' })`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/use-router), also loads static or cached content that depends on the link's [URL data](/docs/app/glossary#url-data), such as [`searchParams`](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/page#searchparams-optional) and [`params`](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/page#params-optional), which the shared shell cannot include. 3. The dashboard now prefetches each project’s cached title. On navigation, the title can appear immediately while the description and activity load afterward. I enabled partial prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts:3), updated the [dashboard links](/workspace/app/page.tsx:15), and separated the title from the deferred details in the [project page](/workspace/app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx:5).

The production build passed. I also checked the prefetch response: it contained the project title and a details loading fallback, but no description or activity. An immediate title depends on that prefetch finishing before the click.
